name: VibeMarketolog - AI Marketing Analyst Agent MVP

parameters.content:
AI Marketing Analyst Agent MVP

Independent n8n workflow for the VibeMarketolog test task.

Flow:
1. Webhook receives a business brief.
2. Free /generate/estimate preflight runs first.
3. Paid /generate runs only after the estimate node succeeds.
4. The workflow returns structured JSON: analysis, audience, hypotheses, offers, creatives, next actions.

In HTTP nodes Vibe - Estimate Cost and Vibe - Generate Analysis replace Authorization header:
Bearer PASTE_VIBE_API_KEY_HERE
with your Vibe Agent API key.

API docs: https://lk.vibemarketolog.ru/docs/agent-api
